title: Selector
description: The closed selector vocabulary ([OAR-SEL-7]). Clauses are conjunctive ([OAR-SEL-2]); an omitted clause is permissive ([OAR-SEL-3]); clauses match machine-observable state only ([OAR-SEL-5]).

surface.description: Session surface the occurrence happens on.

phase.description: Active workflow phase id, or null when unbound.

workflow.description: Workflow catalog id, or null when unbound.

tool.description: Singular tool at tool-lifecycle anchors. Prefer tools when matching a set.

tools.description: Multi-tool match (AND with other clauses). All listed tools are eligible; the engine supplies the concrete tool.

surfaces.description: Session surfaces (e.g. implement_investigate). Plural extension of the singular surface clause.

principal.description: Caller-identity scoping for multi-tenant adopters: a shared-vocabulary role or a list of caller ids.

ledger.description: Typed ledger facts only — never natural language.
